packageRules.description: Minimum supported VS Code: only move engines.vscode to releases at least 1 year old
@types/vscode must not exceed engines.vscode: extra week of age keeps it at or behind the engines bump
engines.node tracks the Node.js runtime bundled with the minimum supported VS Code. Update manually, together with the @types/node allowedVersions cap
@types/node major must match engines.node. Raise this cap when engines.node is raised
TypeScript 7 drops the JS API used by ts-loader 9 and is outside the typescript-eslint peer range (<6.1.0). Raise when both support it
